name: Veronica, Dissident Scribe
oracle_text:
Menace
Whenever Veronica attacks, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
Whenever you discard one or more nonland cards for the first time each turn, create a Junk token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.")
blocked_sentences: Whenever you discard one or more nonland cards for the first time each turn, create a Junk token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.")

needs.what: an `nth` ordinal on the `discard` trigger event, counted off the turn ledger: the place of this discard batch among this turn's discard batches by the trigger's controller that contained a card matching the trigger's `filter` (here `not_types: ["Land"]`), so "whenever you discard one or more nonland cards for the first time each turn" fires on the first such batch of the turn only -- and never later that turn if that batch happened before the permanent entered
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `discard` supports `batched` (Doctor Doom) but its events carry no `nth`, so `_ordinal` returns None and an `nth: 1` trigger never fires; `TurnLedger.cards_discarded` is a bare per-player count with no batch or card record to filter by type. `max_per_turn: 1` with `batched` is a per-permanent cap, which the engine itself documents as wrong for "for the first time each turn" (`_graveyard_ordinal`, Crawling Sensation): Veronica cast after a nonland discard would still fire on a later one. `put_into_graveyard` has the ledger-counted ordinal but also sees mills and deaths, so it is not a discard.
